args.title: Saltmarsh Foods newsletter summary — Retail returns logistics
args.body:
- Newsletter: Saltmarsh Foods' latest newsletter covers retail returns logistics, linking to a blog article and a companion piece (accessible via team licence with company/seat parameters).
- Article: Apparel return rates reached 24%; consolidated return hubs cut handling costs by a fifth.
- Companion piece: Reselling returned items within 10 days preserved most of the margin.
